description:
Get the list of locales and languages that are supported for the user, as configured on the user's mailbox server. When setting up an Outlook client, the user selects the preferred language from this supported list. You can subsequently get the preferred language by
getting the user's mailbox settings.

💡 TIP: Lists locales and languages the user's mailbox server supports for the Outlook UI and message rendering. Returns localeInfo objects with locale (e.g. 'en-US') and displayName ('English (United States)'). Use this to validate the locale value before calling update-mailbox-settings to change the user's preferred language.

count.description: Set true to enable advanced query mode (ConsistencyLevel: eventual). Required for complex $filter on flag/flagStatus or contains().

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure indication

fetchAllPages.description: Follow @odata.nextLink and merge up to 100 pages into one response. Can return enormous payloads—only when the user explicitly needs a full export. Prefer a small $top first, then paginate or narrow with $filter/$search.

filter.description: OData filter expression. Add $count=true for advanced filters (flag/flagStatus, contains()). Cannot combine with $search.

includeHeaders.description: Include response headers (including ETag) in the response metadata

search.description: KQL search query in one pair of double quotes; directory (users/groups) instead quotes each clause with no outer pair. Cannot combine with $filter.

skip.description: Items to skip for pagination. Not supported with $search.

skiptoken.description: Next page: the @odata.nextLink from the previous response. Keep the other arguments the same.

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (e.g. 5–15) so responses fit the model context; raise only if needed. Use $select to return fewer fields per item. For more rows, use @odata.nextLink from the response instead of a very large $top.
